source_feature.name: Veterinary Medicine Isolation Facility
source_feature.transform: Project documented local approximation: X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274°), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040; meters east/north; area centroid local origin
source_feature.measurement_method: GIS polygon converted without scaling; anchor is GIS polygon area centroid.

official_news_source.content: Reports eight 12-by-12-foot stalls, one configured for cattle; treatment/sterilization/storage/office spaces; hallway viewing windows; stall doors display protocol notices. Image depicts interior, not exterior elevations.

official_historic_database_source.provider: Purdue University Libraries Archives and Special Collections

area_conflict.interpretation: The GIS Shape__Area attribute (849.074 m²) materially disagrees with area calculated from its own 12 polygon vertices in the documented local projection (491.252 m²). Published 5,324 sq ft facility area is close to the projected ring area; 2005 Purdue News reports 5,740 sq ft. These values may reflect different measurement bases, but the provider field-vs-ring discrepancy remains unresolved. Model follows source vertices without scaling.

aerial_source.crs: Web Mercator / WKID 3857 tile scheme, imagery reprojection verified by GIS overlay
aerial_source.method: Tile projected from WGS84 Web Mercator quad; GIS ring overlaid. Roof plan broadly aligns; roof is pale/white and two rooftop equipment clusters are visible; wall openings are occluded from above.

additional_identity_source.content: Lists VMIF as Veterinary Medicine Isolation Facility in map grid G10.

modeled_detail.exterior_service_door: One approximately 3 m sliding animal/service door on west facade; conservative placement on aerial-visible paved service side, inferred because aerial does not show door elevation.
modeled_detail.exterior_windows: No unambiguous exterior window pattern is visible in aerial/current sources; none invented.
modeled_detail.facade: Light painted block courses based on the official 2005 interior photo; extending the finish to exterior is an assumption.

model_notes: Exterior footprint follows the official GIS ring at native scale; projected coordinate ring area is 491.252 m² while the same feature Shape__Area attribute says 849.074 m². The roof outline broadly aligns with the imagery; geometry was not rescaled.
Interior stall bays are dimensioned to documented 12 x 12 ft; room arrangement remains inferred because no plan was found.
Single storey follows official GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 / CountOfFLO=1.
Eave is set to 3.60 m and roof top to 3.80 m as visual estimates only. GIS Extrution=12 has undocumented units and was not treated as measured height.
Low-slope, pale roof form and two rooftop equipment clusters follow aerial imagery; exact pitch, parapet and vertical dimensions are unknown.
Wall course detail is visible in official interior photo; matching exterior material/course is a cautious visual extrapolation.

GIS Shape__Area attribute 849.074 m² conflicts with the 491.252 m² calculated from source vertices (72.8% relative to ring area). The projected ring area is close to 5,324 sq ft in Purdue inventory; Purdue News reports 5,740 sq ft. The footprint remains unscaled.
Existing massing used 16 m fallback height; no master or shared placement data was edited.
uncertainty: GIS identity is supported by FID 78, VMIF abbreviation, name, address and GlobalID.
GIS Shape__Area versus coordinate ring area is an unresolved internal provider conflict; the GIS ring itself aligns closely with roof imagery and remains unscaled.
Aerial tile capture date is unknown; it confirms roof silhouette and visible rooftop plant but not elevation.
Exterior service door is a clearly marked inference on the west paved service side, not directly visible in aerial.
Exterior window locations, materials beyond the interior photo, exact eave/roof elevations and room positions remain unverified.
